name: Glycerol + Liquid Sugar
indication_description: Glycerol & Liquid Sugar is indicated in- relief of dry, irritating cough and sore throat. It also assists in relieving productive cough.
pharmacology_description: Glycerol is an osmotic dehydrating agent that possesses hygroscopic and lubricating properties. It causes plasma osmolality leading to the movement of water into the plasma from the extravascular spaces via osmosis.
dosage_description:
Adults including the elderly and children over 5 years: Two 5 ml spoonful (10 ml)
Children 1 to 5 years: One 5 ml spoonful (5 ml)
Children 3 month to 1 year: ½ to 1 spoonful (2.5 to 5 ml)

The dose should be repeated three or four times a day as required.
contraindications_description: Hypersensitivity or intolerance to any of the ingredients.
side_effects_description: This medicine is unlikely to cause side effects unless the patient is allergic to the ingredients.
pregnancy_and_lactation_description: The safety of this medicine during pregnancy and lactation has not been established, but is not considered to constitute a hazard during these periods.
precautions_description: Diabetics should take note of the carbohydrate content of this product. Do not give to children under one year. Keep all medicines out of the reach of children.
overdose_effects_description: Over dosage would not be expected to cause any problems and treatment would be merely symptomatic and supportive.
storage_conditions_description: Should be stored in a cool and dry place, protected from light.
